collapseRule: 1. Blocks visible on no device (all six elementor-hidden-* classes, or only the 1px tablet_extra band) are not rendered; each is written to the ledger as hiddenEverywhere with its text.
2. U = per normalized line, the maximum count over the five device views. K starts empty.
3. Blocks visible on every device are kept first and their lines added to K.

4. Remaining device-limited blocks are visited from widest visibility to narrowest, document order within a tie. A block is kept (as ONE responsive block shown on every device) if any of its lines is still below U in K; otherwise it is a duplicate variant: dropped and written to the ledger as collapsed, naming the kept block.

5. A kept device-limited block that also repeats lines already in K is flagged partialDuplicate for a human merge; a pair of variants that disagree on facts is flagged conflict and goes to the operator.
Result: every line any visitor could see on any device survives exactly as often as the most generous device showed it.
